_comment: Per-million-token prices, in USD. Fill in 'input' and 'output' for the models
you use from the current official pricing page - they are deliberately left at
0.00 here so that a stale number in this repo can never masquerade as a real one.
Cache tiers are optional. When omitted they are derived from 'input' using the
published ratios: 5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2x, read 0.1x. Set them explicitly
if you would rather not rely on the ratio.
Keys match by longest prefix, so 'claude-opus-4-5' prices
